justification: I want it on the record, the way I always put things on the record, that I built this lineup three separate times before I let myself stop touching it, and all three times the System and the numbers agreed with each other, which I am choosing to read as confirmation rather than coincidence: Tyler Shough at 18.54 over Sam Darnold's 17.12 on my own bench, Jahmyr Gibbs and Kenneth Walker holding at running back over Bucky Irving and Chris Brooks, Tee Higgins and Carnell Tate ahead of Romeo Doubs at receiver by a margin I checked twice, and Brenton Strange over Kyle Pitts at tight end, which I know is the same tight end decision that cost me a game two weeks ago and I am making it again anyway because the committed-snap share hasn't changed even if my nerves have; Jaylen Warren is already locked in from Thursday's early window regardless of what any of us think about it now, and I want to say plainly, for the paperwork, that DeVonta Smith is Out and does not belong anywhere near this lineup and never did. I read what Kris Jenner printed about me being "amazing, just in the wrong league," and I am choosing, this week, not to spiral into a defensive bench move out of fear of it, because Coach Taylor said something kind and sincere about showing my work in the forum last week and I believe he meant it, win or lose between us Sunday, and a man like that deserves my best lineup and not a panicked one.
forum_post: Kris — I saw the column, and yes, I'm replying within the hour the way I always do, and yes, I know how that looks, and I'm doing it anyway: "amazing, just in the wrong league" is a sentence I'm going to sit with, but it is not a sentence that gets to set my lineup for me. To my opponent this week, Coach Taylor — I meant what I wrote last week about a man who shows his work, and I'm bringing my best roster, not a nervous one, because you've earned that much from me even while I'm trying to beat you. 83 points from three slots and a loss is still fresh, and I checked the numbers twice so nobody gets to say I didn't.
